examples.en: The sign literally means "no entry" in Chinese.
examples.zh: 這個標誌的中文字面意思是「禁止進入」。

examples.en: I literally have no idea where I left my keys.
examples.zh: 我真的完全不知道把鑰匙放在哪裡了。

examples.en: The shop was literally empty when we arrived at noon.
examples.zh: 我們中午抵達時，那間店裡真的空無一人。

examples.en: They hired a live-in nurse to care for their grandmother.
examples.zh: 他們請了一位住家護理師來照顧奶奶。

examples.en: My aunt works as a live-in housekeeper for a family in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在台北一戶人家擔任住家管家。

examples.en: The couple has been a live-in pair for almost two years.
examples.zh: 這對情侶已經同居將近兩年了。

examples.en: What do you do for a living?
examples.zh: 你是做什麼工作維生的？

examples.en: She makes a living by teaching English online.
examples.zh: 她靠線上教英文維生。

examples.en: The cost of living in big cities keeps rising.
examples.zh: 大城市的生活開銷持續上漲。

examples.en: The museum has a living example of this rare plant.
examples.zh: 博物館裡有這種稀有植物的活體樣本。

examples.en: He is the oldest living member of our family.
examples.zh: 他是我們家族中現存最年長的成員。

examples.en: Living things need water to survive.
examples.zh: 生物需要水才能存活。

examples.en: The llama stood quietly behind the wooden fence.
examples.zh: 那隻羊駝安靜地站在木柵欄後面。

examples.en: Farmers in Peru use a llama to carry heavy bags up the mountain.
examples.zh: 秘魯的農夫用駱馬把重袋子運上山。

examples.en: Our class took photos with a friendly llama at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們班在動物園和一隻友善的羊駝合照。

senses.zh: 裝滿的；裝了子彈的；有錢的

examples.en: The truck was loaded with boxes of fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 這輛卡車裝滿了一箱箱新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: Please check that the camera is loaded with new film.
examples.zh: 請確認相機已經裝好新底片。

examples.en: His uncle is loaded, so he never worries about money.
examples.zh: 他叔叔很有錢，所以從不擔心錢的問題。

examples.en: Several new shops have opened in our locality this year.
examples.zh: 今年我們這一帶開了好幾家新店。

examples.en: The hotel is in a quiet locality near the river.
examples.zh: 這間飯店位在河邊一處安靜的地區。

examples.en: Please give us details about the locality of the accident.
examples.zh: 請提供事故發生地點的詳細資訊。

examples.en: The front door was locked when I got home.
examples.zh: 我回到家時，前門是鎖著的。

examples.en: She found the classroom locked and went to ask the teacher.
examples.zh: 她發現教室鎖著，就去問老師。

examples.en: Keep the cabinet locked so the children cannot open it.
examples.zh: 請把櫃子鎖好，免得孩子打開。

examples.en: The old locomotive pulled ten cars up the hill.
examples.zh: 那輛老火車頭拉著十節車廂爬上山坡。

examples.en: We visited a museum with a steam locomotive from 1920.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了一間展有 1920 年蒸汽火車頭的博物館。

examples.en: The locomotive blew its whistle as it left the station.
examples.zh: 火車頭在駛離車站時鳴了汽笛。

examples.en: A swarm of locusts destroyed the farmers' wheat fields.
examples.zh: 一群蝗蟲毀掉了農夫的麥田。

examples.en: The locust is a type of grasshopper that travels in large groups.
examples.zh: 蝗蟲是一種成群遷徙的蚱蜢。

examples.en: Our science book has a picture of a locust on the cover.
examples.zh: 我們的自然課本封面有一張蝗蟲的圖片。

examples.en: He is a longtime fan of the local baseball team.
examples.zh: 他是當地棒球隊的長年球迷。

examples.en: My longtime neighbor moved away last month.
examples.zh: 我多年的鄰居上個月搬走了。

examples.en: She thanked her longtime friends for their support.
examples.zh: 她感謝多年好友的支持。

examples.en: My grandmother still weaves cloth on an old wooden loom.
examples.zh: 我奶奶還在用一台老舊的木製織布機織布。

examples.en: The museum has a loom that is over two hundred years old.
examples.zh: 博物館有一台已有兩百多年歷史的織布機。

examples.en: Students learned how to use a loom in art class.
examples.zh: 學生們在美術課學習如何使用織布機。

examples.en: A tall building loomed through the thick fog.
examples.zh: 一棟高樓在濃霧中隱隱浮現。

examples.en: Exams are looming, so we need to study harder.
examples.zh: 考試即將來臨，所以我們得更用功讀書。

examples.en: Dark clouds loomed over the town before the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，烏雲籠罩在小鎮上空。

examples.en: The police found the loot hidden in an old barn.
examples.zh: 警方在一間舊穀倉裡找到了贓物。

examples.en: In the video game, you can collect loot after each level.
examples.zh: 在這款電玩遊戲裡，每過一關就能收集戰利品。

examples.en: The museum displays loot taken from ancient ships.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了從古代船隻取得的戰利品。

examples.en: Thieves looted several stores during the power outage.
examples.zh: 停電期間，竊賊洗劫了好幾家商店。

examples.en: Soldiers looted the old temple centuries ago.
examples.zh: 幾百年前，士兵洗劫了這座古廟。

examples.en: The report says the tomb was looted long before the experts arrived.
examples.zh: 報告指出，這座古墓早在專家抵達前就被盜了。

examples.en: A lost child was crying near the station entrance.
examples.zh: 一個迷路的孩子在車站入口附近哭泣。

examples.en: Please hand in any lost items at the front desk.
examples.zh: 撿到遺失物品請交到櫃檯。

examples.en: We are lost, so let's ask someone for directions.
examples.zh: 我們迷路了，去向別人問路吧。

examples.en: Our team lost the game by only one point.
examples.zh: 我們隊伍以一分之差輸掉了比賽。

examples.en: I lost my wallet on the train yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天把錢包弄丟在火車上。

examples.en: She has lost weight since she started swimming.
examples.zh: 她開始游泳後體重減輕了。

examples.en: Mechanics lubricate the engine parts to keep them running well.
examples.zh: 技師替引擎零件上潤滑油，讓它們運轉順暢。

examples.en: You should lubricate the bicycle chain every few months.
examples.zh: 你應該每隔幾個月替腳踏車鏈條上油。

examples.en: Oil is used to lubricate the hinges of the old door.
examples.zh: 人們用油來潤滑那扇舊門的鉸鏈。

examples.en: The workers carried the lumber into the new house.
examples.zh: 工人們把木材搬進新房子。

examples.en: This store sells lumber for building fences and tables.
examples.zh: 這間店販售用來做圍籬和桌子的木材。

examples.en: The country exports a large amount of lumber every year.
examples.zh: 這個國家每年出口大量木材。

examples.en: The big truck lumbered slowly up the narrow road.
examples.zh: 那輛大卡車笨重地沿著窄路緩緩上坡。

examples.en: A tired bear lumbered across the field.
examples.zh: 一隻疲憊的熊笨重地走過田野。

examples.en: The old bus lumbered into the station ten minutes late.
examples.zh: 那輛老舊的公車慢吞吞地駛進車站，晚了十分鐘。

examples.en: The clock has a luminous dial that can be read in the dark.
examples.zh: 這個時鐘有夜光錶面，在黑暗中也看得清楚。

examples.en: Luminous stars filled the sky above the mountain.
examples.zh: 發亮的星星佈滿山上的夜空。

examples.en: The child stuck luminous stickers on her bedroom ceiling.
examples.zh: 那個孩子把夜光貼紙貼在臥室天花板上。

examples.en: The driver was acting like a lunatic on the highway.
examples.zh: 那名駕駛在高速公路上的行為像瘋子一樣。

examples.en: Only a lunatic would swim in that icy lake.
examples.zh: 只有瘋子才會在那個冰冷的湖裡游泳。

examples.en: My brother called me a lunatic for waking up at four.
examples.zh: 我哥哥說我四點起床簡直是瘋了。

examples.en: That is a lunatic idea, and nobody will agree to it.
examples.zh: 那是個瘋狂的點子，沒有人會同意。

examples.en: The manager rejected the lunatic plan right away.
examples.zh: 經理立刻否決了那個荒唐的計畫。

examples.en: He made a lunatic bet that he could finish in an hour.
examples.zh: 他瘋狂地打賭自己一小時就能完成。

examples.en: The cafeteria gets crowded at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 自助餐廳在午餐時間總是很擁擠。

examples.en: Let's meet at lunchtime and talk about the project.
examples.zh: 我們午休時碰面談談這個專案吧。

examples.en: The office is closed during lunchtime on Fridays.
examples.zh: 辦公室每週五午休時間不開放。

examples.en: The history book explains why mobs were once able to lynch people unfairly.
examples.zh: 歷史課本說明了為什麼暴民過去能不公正地對人動用私刑。

examples.en: The film shows how the town leaders tried to stop the mob from trying to lynch him.
examples.zh: 這部電影呈現鎮上領袖如何阻止暴民對他動用私刑。

examples.en: Teachers explained that laws exist so no one will lynch another person.
examples.zh: 老師說明，制定法律是為了不讓任何人對他人動用私刑。

examples.en: I can't remember the lyric of the second verse.
examples.zh: 我想不起第二段的歌詞。

examples.en: She wrote a short lyric about autumn for the school magazine.
examples.zh: 她為校刊寫了一首關於秋天的短詩。

examples.en: He changed one lyric to make the song funnier.
examples.zh: 他改了一句歌詞，讓這首歌更好笑。

examples.en: The poet is famous for her lyric style.
examples.zh: 這位詩人以抒情風格聞名。

examples.en: We studied a lyric poem about the sea in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上讀了一首關於大海的抒情詩。

examples.en: His lyric voice made the whole audience stop and listen.
examples.zh: 他抒情的嗓音讓全場觀眾都停下來聆聽。

senses.zh: 捏造的；虛構的；化了妝的

examples.en: The story about the ghost was completely made-up.
examples.zh: 那個鬼的故事完全是捏造的。

examples.en: Kids love reading about made-up worlds with dragons.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡讀有龍存在的虛構世界。

examples.en: She arrived at the party fully made-up and ready to dance.
examples.zh: 她化好了妝，準備好跳舞，來到派對現場。

examples.en: The movie tells the story of a famous mafia family.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一個著名黑手黨家族的故事。

examples.en: The police worked for years to break up the mafia.
examples.zh: 警方花了數年時間瓦解這個犯罪集團。

examples.en: Our teacher said the mafia began in Italy long ago.
examples.zh: 老師說黑手黨很久以前起源於義大利。

examples.en: The magistrate listened carefully to both sides of the story.
examples.zh: 地方法官仔細聆聽雙方的說法。

examples.en: A local magistrate handled the case in just one day.
examples.zh: 當地一位法官一天就處理完這個案子。

examples.en: My uncle works as a magistrate in a small town.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在一個小鎮擔任地方法官。

examples.en: The earthquake had a magnitude of 6.5.
examples.zh: 這場地震的規模是六點五。

examples.en: We did not understand the magnitude of the problem at first.
examples.zh: 我們起初並不了解這個問題的嚴重程度。

examples.en: Scientists measured the magnitude of the star's brightness.
examples.zh: 科學家測量了這顆星星的亮度等級。

examples.en: The making of this cake takes about two hours.
examples.zh: 製作這個蛋糕大約需要兩個小時。

examples.en: The movie was three years in the making.
examples.zh: 這部電影籌拍了三年。

examples.en: She is a leader in the making.
examples.zh: 她是個正在養成中的領袖。

examples.en: Malaria is spread by mosquitoes in warm countries.
examples.zh: 瘧疾在溫暖的國家由蚊子傳播。

examples.en: Travelers may need medicine to protect themselves from malaria.
examples.zh: 旅客可能需要吃藥來預防瘧疾。

examples.en: Doctors are working on a new vaccine against malaria.
examples.zh: 醫生們正在研發對抗瘧疾的新疫苗。

examples.en: The driver made a quick maneuver to avoid the box on the road.
examples.zh: 駕駛迅速轉向，避開路上的箱子。

examples.en: The company's clever maneuver helped it win the contract.
examples.zh: 這間公司巧妙的策略幫助它贏得了合約。

examples.en: The navy held a training maneuver off the coast.
examples.zh: 海軍在近海舉行了訓練演習。

examples.en: It is hard to maneuver a big truck in a narrow alley.
examples.zh: 在窄巷中操控大卡車很困難。

examples.en: She tried to maneuver her chair closer to the window.
examples.zh: 她設法把椅子巧妙地挪近窗邊。

examples.en: The pilot maneuvered the plane around the dark clouds.
examples.zh: 機師操縱飛機繞過烏雲。

examples.en: The new party published its manifesto before the election.
examples.zh: 新政黨在選舉前發表了政見宣言。

examples.en: The artists wrote a manifesto about their goals for the group.
examples.zh: 藝術家們寫了一份關於團體目標的宣言。

examples.en: Our club's manifesto says we will keep the park clean.
examples.zh: 我們社團的宣言寫著我們會維持公園整潔。

examples.en: The mare walked slowly beside her young foal.
examples.zh: 那匹母馬慢慢走在牠的小馬旁邊。

examples.en: Our neighbor bought a brown mare for the farm.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居替牧場買了一匹棕色母馬。

examples.en: The mare is gentle, so children can ride her.
examples.zh: 這匹母馬性情溫和，所以小朋友可以騎牠。

examples.en: There has been a marked improvement in your English.
examples.zh: 你的英文有了明顯的進步。

examples.en: Please use the marked path to reach the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 請沿著標示好的小路走到山頂。

examples.en: The marked change in the weather surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 天氣的明顯變化讓大家都很驚訝。

examples.en: The teacher marked our tests and returned them on Monday.
examples.zh: 老師批改我們的考卷，星期一就發還了。

examples.en: She marked the date on the calendar with a red pen.
examples.zh: 她用紅筆在日曆上標出日期。

examples.en: The festival marked the end of the long winter.
examples.zh: 這個節慶標誌著漫長冬天的結束。

examples.en: She works in marketing for a large clothing company.
examples.zh: 她在一間大型服飾公司擔任行銷工作。

examples.en: Good marketing can help a small shop attract more customers.
examples.zh: 好的行銷能幫小店吸引更多顧客。

examples.en: The marketing team is planning a new online campaign.
examples.zh: 行銷團隊正在規劃一個新的線上活動。

examples.en: Many birds live in the marsh near our town.
examples.zh: 我們鎮附近的濕地有很多鳥類棲息。

examples.en: We walked along a wooden path across the marsh.
examples.zh: 我們沿著一條木棧道穿越沼澤。

examples.en: The marsh became dry during the long summer.
examples.zh: 漫長的夏天讓這片沼澤乾涸了。

examples.en: The marshal led the parade through the center of town.
examples.zh: 典禮官帶領遊行隊伍穿過市中心。

examples.en: A fire marshal checked the building before the concert.
examples.zh: 消防隊員在音樂會前檢查了這棟建築。

examples.en: The old marshal received a medal for his service.
examples.zh: 那位老元帥因其貢獻獲頒一枚勳章。

examples.en: The teacher marshaled the students into two neat lines.
examples.zh: 老師把學生整頓成兩排整齊的隊伍。

examples.en: She marshaled her ideas before the big speech.
examples.zh: 她在重要演講前整理好自己的想法。

examples.en: The manager marshaled the whole team to finish the report.
examples.zh: 經理召集整個團隊一起完成報告。

examples.en: First, mash the potatoes with a fork.
examples.zh: 首先，用叉子把馬鈴薯壓成泥。

examples.en: Mom likes to mash bananas for the baby.
examples.zh: 媽媽喜歡把香蕉壓成泥給寶寶吃。

examples.en: You can mash the beans and spread them on bread.
examples.zh: 你可以把豆子搗碎後塗在麵包上。

examples.en: We had chicken with mash for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了雞肉配馬鈴薯泥。

examples.en: The cook added butter to the mash.
examples.zh: 廚師在馬鈴薯泥裡加了奶油。

examples.en: A bowl of warm mash is perfect for a cold night.
examples.zh: 一碗溫熱的馬鈴薯泥最適合寒冷的夜晚。

examples.en: The museum teaches students about the massacre in history class.
examples.zh: 博物館在歷史課上向學生介紹那場大屠殺。

examples.en: The monument remembers the victims of the massacre.
examples.zh: 這座紀念碑追念大屠殺的受難者。

examples.en: Our team suffered a massacre in the final game, losing by thirty points.
examples.zh: 我們隊在決賽中慘敗，輸了三十分。

examples.en: History books describe how soldiers massacred the villagers long ago.
examples.zh: 歷史書描述了很久以前士兵屠殺村民的經過。

examples.en: The film shows the sad story of a town where people were massacred.
examples.zh: 這部電影描述一個小鎮居民遭到屠殺的悲傷故事。

examples.en: Many nations have promised never to massacre civilians again.
examples.zh: 許多國家承諾不再屠殺平民。

examples.en: Some people worry that materialism is hurting young people.
examples.zh: 有些人擔心物質主義正在傷害年輕人。

examples.en: The writer criticizes the materialism of modern society.
examples.zh: 這位作家批評現代社會的物質主義。

examples.en: Our philosophy teacher explained the difference between materialism and idealism.
examples.zh: 我們的哲學老師解釋了唯物論與唯心論的差異。

examples.en: I like a little mayonnaise on my sandwich.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在三明治上加一點美乃滋。

examples.en: Mix the tuna with some mayonnaise and chopped onions.
examples.zh: 把鮪魚和一些美乃滋及洋蔥丁拌在一起。

examples.en: The mayonnaise in the fridge has expired.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡的美乃滋過期了。

examples.en: The tailor took my measurement before making the suit.
examples.zh: 裁縫師在做西裝前先量了我的尺寸。

examples.en: Careful measurement is important in every science experiment.
examples.zh: 仔細測量對每個科學實驗都很重要。

examples.en: Please write down the measurement of the window in centimeters.
examples.zh: 請把窗戶的尺寸以公分寫下來。

examples.en: My brother is studying mechanics at a technical college.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在技術學院念機械學。

examples.en: The mechanics of the game are easy to learn.
examples.zh: 這個遊戲的運作機制很容易學會。

examples.en: The class covered the basic mechanics of how a bicycle works.
examples.zh: 這堂課講解了腳踏車運作的基本原理。

examples.en: The tea has a mellow taste that I really enjoy.
examples.zh: 這款茶的味道醇厚柔和，我很喜歡。

examples.en: Soft, mellow music played in the cafe.
examples.zh: 咖啡廳裡播放著輕柔舒緩的音樂。

examples.en: My grandfather has become more mellow as he has gotten older.
examples.zh: 我爺爺隨著年紀增長，變得更隨和了。

examples.en: His anger began to mellow after a good night's sleep.
examples.zh: 睡了一個好覺後，他的怒氣開始消退。

examples.en: Wine can mellow if you keep it for many years.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒若存放多年，口感會變得圓潤。

examples.en: She hopes her brother will mellow as he grows up.
examples.zh: 她希望弟弟長大後脾氣能變得溫和一些。

examples.en: Speeding drivers are a menace to everyone on the road.
examples.zh: 超速的駕駛是路上所有人的威脅。

examples.en: The little dog is a menace when it chews the furniture.
examples.zh: 那隻小狗啃咬家具時簡直是個搗蛋鬼。

examples.en: Pollution is a growing menace to our oceans.
examples.zh: 汙染對我們的海洋是日益嚴重的威脅。

examples.en: Dark clouds menaced the coast all afternoon.
examples.zh: 烏雲整個下午都威脅著海岸地區。

examples.en: The new rules menace the survival of small farms.
examples.zh: 新規定威脅到小型農場的生存。

examples.en: A large storm menaced the town last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚一場大風暴威脅著小鎮。

examples.en: Old thermometers used mercury to measure temperature.
examples.zh: 舊式溫度計用水銀來測量溫度。

examples.en: Mercury is the closest planet to the sun.
examples.zh: 水星是離太陽最近的行星。

examples.en: Some fish contain mercury, which is harmful to people.
examples.zh: 有些魚含有汞，對人體有害。

examples.en: The two banks announced a merger last week.
examples.zh: 這兩家銀行上週宣布合併。

examples.en: The merger will create one of the largest companies in the country.
examples.zh: 這項合併將成立全國最大的公司之一。

examples.en: Many employees were worried about the merger.
examples.zh: 許多員工對這次併購感到擔憂。

examples.en: The old pipe made a metallic sound when I hit it.
examples.zh: 我敲那根舊水管時，它發出金屬般的聲響。

examples.en: She bought a car with a metallic blue finish.
examples.zh: 她買了一輛金屬藍烤漆的車。

examples.en: The water had a strange metallic taste.
examples.zh: 這水有一種奇怪的金屬味。

examples.en: Most countries use the metric system to measure length.
examples.zh: 大多數國家使用公制來測量長度。

examples.en: A meter is a basic metric unit of length.
examples.zh: 公尺是長度的基本公制單位。

examples.en: We converted the recipe to metric measurements.
examples.zh: 我們把食譜換算成公制單位。

examples.en: Sales are the main metric for judging this store's success.
examples.zh: 銷售額是評斷這家店成功與否的主要指標。

examples.en: The company uses several metrics to track customer happiness.
examples.zh: 這間公司用好幾項指標來追蹤顧客的滿意度。

examples.en: Test scores are only one metric of a student's progress.
examples.zh: 考試成績只是衡量學生進步的其中一項指標。

examples.en: Many birds migrate south for the winter.
examples.zh: 許多鳥類會在冬天往南遷徙。

examples.en: Some families migrate to the city to find better jobs.
examples.zh: 有些家庭為了找更好的工作而移居到城市。

examples.en: Whales migrate thousands of kilometers every year.
examples.zh: 鯨魚每年遷徙數千公里。

examples.en: The car has low mileage and is in good condition.
examples.zh: 這輛車的里程數很低，狀況良好。

examples.en: This model gets excellent gas mileage on the highway.
examples.zh: 這個車款在高速公路上的油耗表現很優秀。

examples.en: You can claim the mileage when you travel for work.
examples.zh: 因公出差時你可以申請里程補助。

examples.en: The union took a more militant position in the talks.
examples.zh: 工會在談判中採取更強硬的立場。

examples.en: Some militant groups refused to join the peace talks.
examples.zh: 有些激進團體拒絕參加和談。

examples.en: The newspaper described his militant speech as too angry.
examples.zh: 報紙認為他那篇激進的演說太過憤怒。

examples.en: The report says the militant had left the country.
examples.zh: 報告指出那名激進分子已離開該國。

examples.en: Several militants were arrested by the local police.
examples.zh: 數名激進分子被當地警方逮捕。

examples.en: The leader said he was not a militant but a peaceful organizer.
examples.zh: 這位領導人說他不是激進分子，而是和平的組織者。

examples.en: The town formed a militia to protect its farms.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮組成民兵團來保護農場。

examples.en: The history book explains how the militia fought for the colony.
examples.zh: 歷史課本說明民兵如何為殖民地而戰。

examples.en: Members of the militia trained every weekend in the field.
examples.zh: 民兵成員每個週末都在野外訓練。

examples.en: The miller ground the wheat into fine flour.
examples.zh: 磨坊主人把小麥磨成細麵粉。

examples.en: My great-grandfather worked as a miller in a small village.
examples.zh: 我曾祖父在一個小村莊當磨坊工人。

examples.en: The miller sold sacks of flour to the local bakery.
examples.zh: 磨坊主人把一袋袋麵粉賣給當地的麵包店。
